summary.text: Bruce Tarr is a Republican state senator from Massachusetts who has represented the 1st Essex and Middlesex District since 1995 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he served in the state House from 1991 to 1995 and is the ranking minority member on several Senate and joint committees.

paragraphs.text: Tarr was born on January 2, 1964, and earned a bachelor's degree in management from Suffolk University in 1987 and a juris doctor from the Suffolk University School of Law in 1990.
His professional experience includes working as an attorney.
Tarr represented the 5th Essex District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 1991 to 1995.
He assumed office in the Senate in 1995.

For the 2025-2026 session he is the ranking minority member of the Senate Bills in the Third Reading Committee, the Steering and Policy Committee, and the Joint Committees on Financial Services, on Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture, on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, and on Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy.
